title: Aspects Reforged
description: Adding more aspect enchants because why not.
body:
This datapack adds 9 different new enchantments for swords based off the og Fire Aspect

- Sticky Aspect
  - Summons a honey block at the victim's feet
- Water Aspect
  - Summons water at the victim's feet
- Frost Aspect
  - Summons powdered snow at the victim's feet
- Burning Aspect
  - Summons lava at the victim's feet
- Levitating Aspect
  - Applies Levitation to victim for a random time between 5 seconds and 60 seconds
- Explosive Aspect
  - Summons TNT at the victims feet
- Withering Aspect
  - Applies Wither effect to victim for a random time between 5 seconds and 60 seconds
- Shocking Aspect
  - Summons lightning at victim
- Poison Aspect
  - Applies Poison effect to victim for a random time between 30 seconds and 60 seconds
